comparison.objective: Open a shelf-ready can tray by tearing off its front panel along a perforation.
comparison.physical_skill: Grip initiation, supported progressive tearing, force-direction control, and separation along a predefined weak line.
comparison.success_condition: Front panel separates along the perforation while the tray and cans remain acceptably intact, contained, and undamaged.
comparison.reason: Both tasks intentionally separate material at a weak line, but this record tests progressive sheet tear of one large panel; the candidate tests coaxial mandrel stabilization, discrete hammer impacts, preservation of four retained coils, and recovery of four millimetre-scale tangs.
